notes: 'I am against thee' puts the supplied copula on the prepositional predicate, headed on the preposition (rule 49).
גַּם takes 'even' and the explicit pronoun אָנִי the second 'I'; the suffix of הִנְנִי takes the first.
'in the sight of the nations' places the written 'the' before 'nations' on the article and a supplied one on the construct (rule 29).
